verdict.rationale: Mercury's own materials describe granular user permissions and approvals, payments with "optional approval controls" governed by organization approval policies, and a customer quote that built-in permissions let an accountant make payments in "literally one click." Bill pay is also described as "approve and pay in seconds." The core story is covered, but all evidence is vendor marketing or reference snippets. missing for 10: detailed documentation on configuring approver roles and approval rules for designated teammates, independent or hands-on corroboration of the one-click approve-and-send workflow.
